args.title: Fix README: npm run serve should be npm start
args.body:
File: README.md

The "Running locally" section tells readers to run `npm run build` then `npm run serve`, but package.json only defines a `start` script (no `serve`). Replace `npm run serve` with `npm start` in step 5 of the Running locally section.

label: docs
file: README.md
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

package.json defines a `start` script, not `serve`; the README's "Running locally" section should say `npm start` instead of `npm run serve` in step 5. Opened a PR to fix this.
